product.description: Monoprice™ Commercial SeriesHeavy Duty XL Full‑Motion Articulating Extra Long Reach TV Wall Mount BracketFor TVs 60in to 110in, Max Weight 275 lbs, Extension Range 4.3in to 38.6in, VESA® Up to 800x600The Monoprice™ Commercial Series Heavy Duty XL Full‑Motion Articulating Extra Long Reach TV Wall Mount Bracket is the ultimate solution for mounting large, widescreen TVs in commercial or residential settings. Designed to accommodate TVs ranging from 60 inches to a massive 110 inches, this robust wall mount can support a maximum weight of 275 pounds, ensuring that even the heaviest displays can be securely mounted.One of the standout features of this TV wall mount is its exceptional range of motion. With full articulation capabilities, including screen level rotation, tilt, swivel, and dual extra long heavy‑duty extension arms, you can easily adjust your TV to achieve the perfect viewing angle. Whether you want to watch TV from the comfort of your couch or need to adjust the screen for a better view in a large conference room, this wall mount provides the flexibility you need.The mount's extra‑long extension range of up to 38.6 inches allows you to pull your TV away from the wall, making it easier to access the back of the display for cable management or connecting additional devices. This extension range also ensures that your TV can be positioned at the perfect distance from your seating area, providing an immersive viewing experience.The sliding wall plate feature adds even more versatility to the mounting process. It enables corner installation flexibility, making it possible to mount your TV in the corner of a room, saving space and creating a visually appealing setup. Whether you have a large living room, a conference hall, or a commercial space, this TV wall mount allows you to make the most of your available area.To ensure compatibility with a wide range of TV models, the Monoprice Commercial Series Heavy Duty XL Full‑Motion Articulating Extra Long Reach TV Wall Mount supports VESA mounting patterns from 100x100 up to a massive 800x600. This broad range of VESA patterns covers most modern TVs, ensuring a seamless and secure fit.The mount offers a generous swivel range of 110 degrees, allowing you to easily adjust the angle of your TV horizontally. This feature is particularly useful in environments where multiple seating areas need a clear view of the screen, such as sports bars or large living rooms where people gather for movie nights. You can also adjust the vertical angle of your TV to eliminate glare and optimize the viewing experience with the mount's tilt range of ‑5 degrees to 10 degrees. Whether you're watching your favorite TV shows, movies, or playing video games, this tilt range enables you to achieve the best picture quality with minimal reflection. Additionally, the mount offers a rotation range of ±5 degrees. This rotation capability allows you to easily switch between landscape and portrait screen mounting orientations, making it ideal for digital signage or installations where the display needs to be adjusted for different content formats.In conclusion, the Monoprice Commercial Series Heavy Duty XL Full‑Motion Articulating Extra Long Reach TV Wall Mount Bracket is a versatile and durable solution for mounting large TVs. With its heavy‑duty construction, extended reach, and comprehensive range of motion, this wall mount ensures that you can enjoy optimal viewing angles and flexibility for TVs ranging from 60 inches to a staggering 110 inches. Whether you need to mount a TV in a commercial space, conference room, or expansive living room, this wall mount provides the reliability and functionality you require.Extra long extension up to 38.6"Heavy‑duty design for 60" ∼ 110" displays of up to 275 lbs.Sliding wall plateAccommodates VESA patterns of 100x100 to 800x600110° Swivel range‑5° ∼ 10° Tilt range±5° Rotation rangeSuitable for landscape or portrait screen mounting HEAVY‑DUTY DESIGN FOR EXTRA LARGE TVSThis Monoprice™ Commercial Series TV wall mount was built to hold an extra large display ranging up to 110". It features a 27" wall plate, with dual extra‑long heavy‑duty extension arms, constructed with high quality, cold‑rolled steel capable of supporting up to 275 pounds. FIND YOUR MOST COMFORTABLE VIEWING ANGLEMonoprice™ full‑motion wall mounts offer the ultimate in comfort and flexibility. This XL mount boasts extra long swing arms allowing for an extension of nearly 39". The fully articulating mount also gives the ability to tilt your TV up or down, swivel from side to side, and rotate to ensure it is level. EASILY CENTER YOUR TVThe Commercial Series XL Mount also features a smooth sliding wall plate track, with up to 24" of side‑to‑side movement, allowing for easy TV centering. "IS THIS MOUNT COMPATIBLE WITH MY TV?"• Check your TV's manual for its VESA® mounting pattern or measure the horizontal and vertical distances between the mounting holes (in mm).• This mount supports VESA patterns between 100x100 and 800x600.• This mount supports TVs weighing up to 275 pounds.• The screen size range is only a suggested approximation.
